metadata.description: Red tiles form lobed oak leaves and two capped acorns. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Broken spiral approach surround the motif, with staggered terraces along the lower route. 5 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 8 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
